senses.gloss: झरी झरी (probably a form of a [] derivative from क्षर्), f. A waterfall, Prab. 73, 1.

† झर्च् झर्च्, झर्छ् झर्छ्, झर्झ् झर्झ्, i. 1, and 6, Par.
 1. To explain.
 2. To menace.
 3. To hurt.
झर्झर झर्झर, i. e. झर्झर्, a reduplicated form of an imitative sound, + अ, m. and f. री, A kind of drum, MBh. 6, 4463; Rām. 6, 99, 23 (but Sch., A flute); Hariv. 13212.
झर्झरिन् झर्झरिन्, i. e. झर्झर + इन्, adj. Provided with a drum, MBh. 12, 10406.
